reasoning_content: The base image has a `vscode` user, but with `bash -c` I can't find ruby? That's weird. Let me check where ruby is installed in that image.

action.command: docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/bash ghcr.io/rails/devcontainer/images/ruby:3.4.9 -c 'ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---; find / -name "ruby" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head -5; echo ---; ls /usr/local/rvm 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; cat /home/vscode/.bashrc 2>/dev/null | head -30'

tool_call.name: terminal
